name: particle bomb (single vertex)
description: Single 'particle bomb' interaction per event (no pile-up). Draws a per-event multiplicity N=Uniform(1,5), then samples N particles (with replacement) from the candidate pool {e-, mu-, pi+, pi-, pi0, gamma}. Kinetic energies are uniform in [1, 2000] MeV for e-, [200, 2000] MeV for mu-/pi+/pi-/pi0, and [1, 2130] MeV for gamma - the upper end is the endpoint for a gamma from a pi0 decay at the dataset's maximum pi0 energy ((E+p)/2 = 2132.8 MeV at KE = 2000 MeV), rounded down. Isotropic direction. This is the training set; the single-particle configs are test-only.
